-- incarnation from health_check_4.4 (Jon Adams and Jack Agustin)
SELECT /*+  NO_MERGE  */ /* 2a.86 */
       x.*
       ,c.name con_name
  FROM cdb_objects x
       LEFT OUTER JOIN v$containers c ON c.con_id = x.con_id
 WHERE x.status = 'INVALID'
 ORDER BY
       x.con_id,
       x.owner,
       x.object_name;
